# lifecycle

The session state machine, liveness, reconcile on start, shutdown policy, resume to idle.

Read first: `docs/features/lifecycle/spec.md`, `docs/features/lifecycle/contract.md`

- `kb:fact/background-completion-new-prompt-id` — A finished background task re-invokes the main agent as a UserPromptSubmit with a new prompt_id whose prompt begins <task-notification>. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-completion-new-prompt-id.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-delivery-best-effort` — Hooks are at-most-once with no timestamps or sequence numbers; kill -9 emits nothing and a SIGTERM emits SessionEnd but no Stop-family event. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-delivery-best-effort.md`
- `kb:fact/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit` — On the authentication-failure exit Claude Code does not wait for hook children: StopFailure is at risk and SessionEnd is usually lost. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.246..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, canary) → `docs/facts/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/notification-types-observed` — Notification.notification_type: idle_prompt ~60 s after Stop, and permission_prompt sharing PermissionRequest's prompt_id. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/notification-types-observed.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-presence-split` — permission_mode is not universal: six hook events always carry it, five never do; values seen are default, plan, acceptEdits, auto. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-presence-split.md`
- `kb:fact/plan-mode-hook-sequence` — Leaving plan mode fires PreToolUse{ExitPlanMode, plan}, then PermissionRequest{ExitPlanMode}, then PostToolUse{ExitPlanMode, acceptEdits}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/plan-mode-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/resume-keeps-session-identity` — claude --resume <id> emits SessionStart{source:"resume"} with the original session_id and transcript_path. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-keeps-session-identity.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionend-reason-ambiguous` — SessionEnd.reason is "other" for both a killed pane and a normal exit; only "clear" is distinguishable, and kill -9 emits nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionend-reason-ambiguous.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-model-optional-string` — SessionStart.model, when present, is a plain model-ID string, never an object; it is absent on headless startups and on /clear. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-model-optional-string.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-error-taxonomy` — StopFailure.error observed: authentication_failed, server_error, unknown; ten values exist in the binary, and the mapping is not pass-through. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-error-taxonomy.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-replaces-stop` — A failed turn emits StopFailure instead of Stop, never both; a successful turn emits Stop only. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-replaces-stop.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id` — Tool hooks fired by a subagent carry the parent prompt_id plus agent_id and agent_type, and arrive after the parent's Stop when backgrounded. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-permission-request-marked` — A subagent's PermissionRequest carries agent_id and agent_type; the permission_prompt Notification that follows carries no agent marker. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/subagent-permission-request-marked.md`
